image_policy: Screenshot binaries are retained in the ignored repository-local run directory and are not committed. Each row records its image digest, runtime assertions, in-run URL/revision receipt, and an externally viewable HTTPS copy with the upload exchange from this run.

captures.name: root-shell-initial-desktop
captures.assertion: Bare production root remains on the Near You shell with local entry and global navigation available.

captures.name: root-midwood-result-desktop

captures.name: root-midwood-meeting-detail-desktop
captures.assertion: The third action from production root opens the exact September 23 meeting detail.

snapshot.title: Housing and Land Use Committee Meeting · CityScroll

captures.name: shared-midwood-route-desktop
captures.assertion: The shared production Midwood route reconstructs independently with the September 23 row.

captures.assertion: A denied production geolocation request keeps the Near You shell and typed place recovery available.

snapshot.title: Near you · CityScroll

captures.name: root-failure-recovery-kensington-desktop

captures.name: root-kensington-wider-result-desktop
captures.assertion: Choosing Kensington from production root shows the September 23 row as wider-district activity.

captures.name: root-kensington-wider-detail-desktop
captures.assertion: The wider-district row opened from Kensington reaches the exact September 23 detail.

snapshot.title: Housing and Land Use Committee Meeting · CityScroll
